description: This file contains internal hash function implementations based on MurmurHash3, including functions for rotating bits, getting unaligned blocks, and finalizing hash values. It defines inline functions for 32-bit and 64-bit hash operations, tailored for internal use within jemalloc.

methods.name: hash_rotl_32
methods.description: Performs a 32-bit rotate left operation on the input integer.

methods.name: hash_rotl_64
methods.description: Performs a 64-bit rotate left operation on the input integer.

methods.name: hash_get_block_32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit block from a potentially unaligned memory address.

methods.name: hash_get_block_64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit block from a potentially unaligned memory address.

methods.name: hash_fmix_32
methods.description: Final mixing function for 32-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_fmix_64
methods.description: Final mixing function for 64-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_x86_32
methods.description: Hash function based on MurmurHash3 for 32-bit architectures.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Public API function that computes a hash for given data and seed, selecting implementation based on pointer size and endianness.
